message:
You know that one friend who seems to always be ready for anything? We recently found ourselves at a picnic when a sudden rainstorm rolled in. While everyone scrambled for cover, our gloriously over-prepared friend pulled out a waterproof tarp, extra ponchos, and even a few snacks from their go-bag. It was a bit comical, but it reminded us of the importance of being prepared, even for the unexpected joys in life! 

We might not need a full go-bag for every outing, but having a few essentials handy can make all the difference. What’s your favorite tip for staying prepared on the go?
